export const escapeKey = (key: string) => 
  key.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/\./g, '\\.');

export const parsePath = (string: StringifiedPath, legacy: boolean = true) => {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let segment = '';
  
  for (let i = 0; i < string.length; i++) {
    let char = string.charAt(i);
    
    if (char === '\\') {
      const next = string.charAt(i + 1);
      
      if (legacy) {
        // Legacy: only \. is an escape
        if (next === '.') {
          segment += '.';
          i++;
        } else {
          segment += char;
        }
      } else {
        // Non-legacy: \\ is escaped backslash, \. is escaped dot
        if (next === '\\') {
          segment += '\\';
          i++;
        } else if (next === '.') {
          segment += '.';
          i++;
        } else {
          throw new Error(`Invalid escape sequence: \\${next || '(end of string)'}`);
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    
    if (char === '.') {
      result.push(segment);
      segment = '';
      continue;
    }
    
    segment += char;
  }
  
  result.push(segment);
  return result;
};
```

export const escapeKey = (key: string) =>

export const parsePath = (string: StringifiedPath, legacy: boolean = true) => {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let segment = '';
  
  for (let i = 0; i < string.length; i++) {
    let char = string.charAt(i);
    
    if (char === '\\') {
      const next = string.charAt(i + 1);
      
      if (legacy) {
        // Legacy: only \. is an escape
        if (next === '.') {
          segment += '.';
          i++;
        } else {
          segment += char;
        }
      } else {
        // Non-legacy: \\ is escaped backslash, \. is escaped dot
        if (next === '\\') {
          segment += '\\';
          i++;
        } else if (next === '.') {
          segment += '.';
          i++;
        } else {
          throw new Error(`Invalid escape sequence: \\${next || '(end of string)'}`);
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    
    if (char === '.') {
      result.push(segment);
      segment = '';
      continue;
    }
    
    segment += char;
  }
  
  result.push(segment);
  return result;
};

export const parsePath = (string: StringifiedPath, legacy: boolean = true) => {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let segment = '';
  
  for (let i = 0; i < string.length; i++) {
    let char = string.charAt(i);
    
    if (char === '\\') {
      const next = string.charAt(i + 1);
      
      if (legacy) {
        // Legacy: only \. is an escape
        if (next === '.') {
          segment += '.';
          i++;
        } else {
          segment += char;
        }
      } else {
        // Non-legacy: \\ is escaped backslash, \. is escaped dot
        if (next === '\\') {
          segment += '\\';
          i++;
        } else if (next === '.') {
          segment += '.';
          i++;
        } else {
          throw new Error(`Invalid escape sequence: \\${next || '(end of string)'}`);
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    
    if (char === '.') {
      result.push(segment);
      segment = '';
      continue;
    }
    
    segment += char;
  }
  
  result.push(segment);
  return result;
};

export const escapeKey = (key: string) => 
  key.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/\./g, '\\.');

export const parsePath = (string: StringifiedPath, legacy: boolean = true) => {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let segment = '';
  
  for (let i = 0; i < string.length; i++) {
    let char = string.charAt(i);
    
    if (char === '\\') {
      const next = string.charAt(i + 1);
      
      if (legacy) {
        // Legacy: only \. is an escape
        if (next === '.') {
          segment += '.';
          i++;
        } else {
          segment += char;
        }
      } else {
        // Non-legacy: \\ is escaped backslash, \. is escaped dot
        if (next === '\\') {
          segment += '\\';
          i++;
        } else if (next === '.') {
          segment += '.';
          i++;
        } else {
          throw new Error(`Invalid escape sequence: \\${next || '(end of string)'}`);
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    
    if (char === '.') {
      result.push(segment);
      segment = '';
      continue;
    }
    
    segment += char;
  }
  
  result.push(segment);
  return result;
};
```
